title: An Invitations send queue waits and asks aMember again for 30 minutes before pausing, and tells the ops topic when the cron pauses it
steps: Run the Invitations real send test file from this branch against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL), with a fake aMember that stops answering and a fake clock past the retry window.
expect: While aMember fails for less than AMEMBER_RETRY_MS the queue stays running, the cron pass answers waiting REAL_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN, and no item is sent or skipped.
A clear aMember answer in between clears amember_failing_since, so the window starts again from the next failure.
Once aMember has failed for the whole window the queue pauses with reason REAL_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN.
Every pause the cron makes records one invitations.queue_paused signal with campaign_id and reason, and its ops topic text names the reason and the campaign.
Gmail not answering, the budget reached and sending turned off still pause at once.
fence: Synthetic customers, fake aMember and fake Gmail transport on a private PostgreSQL; no live source, no mailbox, no Telegram.

tests: send queue: aMember not answering waits and asks again, pauses only after the retry window, and tells the ops topic
